messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: continuous-batcher pool in us-west-2 is reporting repeated CUDA OOMs and GPU pagefaults across multiple nodes. Auto-escalation triggered.

devon: seeing the same in logs — batch size climbing steadily, KV cache blowout, then container SIGKILL.

liam: I'm oncall, taking this. quick ask: any customer-facing 5xxs?

maya: yes — PG gen endpoints showing 504s and 10–20x latency spikes. Dashboard: token latency p95 jumped from 120ms -> 3.2s. Affected routers: gen-v2 and chat-stream.

charu: repro logs from node ip-10-0-45-7:
```
E cuda: out of memory when allocating 2.0 GiB at continuous_batcher.cpp:412
W kvcache: growth=1.2GB, limit=1.0GB
I evict: failed to evict prefix, hold count=2
```

liam: thanks. immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch and batching, 2) cordon/evict the flapping nodes, 3) failover traffic to us-east. Who can flip flags?

devon: I can flip the runtime flags. Which keys?

liam: set PREFETCH_ENABLED=false and MAX_BATCH_SLOTS=8 for continuous-batcher service. Also lower BATCH_SIZE_SOFT=64 -> 32.

devon: doing it now. patching configmap and rolling update with zero-downtime drain: `kubectl -n inference patch cm runtime-flags --patch '{"data":{"PREFETCH_ENABLED":"false","MAX_BATCH_SLOTS":"8","BATCH_SIZE_SOFT":"32"}}'`

ops-bot: deploy-bot invoked: rollout restart deployment/continuous-batcher (namespace inference).

incident-bot: Incident assigned: INCIDENT-2026-0432. Priority: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/continuous-batcher-paging

maya: after flag flip and restart, early telemetry shows drop in pagefaults and OOMs on restarted pods. Latency trending down but still noisy.

charu: one node still flapping — kernel logs show repeated GPU reset: `NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus`. Suspect hardware or driver.

liam: cordon and replace that node. devon, can you initiate node drain and scale up nodes by +2 to absorb load?

devon: draining ip-10-0-45-7 now: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-45-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Scaling nodepool continuous-a1 +2.

maya: customer impact note: around 120 orgs saw degraded responses, ~30 reported errors. CS alerted and posting status page update.

charu: also discovered a rare deadlock in batch-accumulator when KV eviction fails — reproducer in test harness. Looks like growth loop: prefetch pushes prefixes -> eviction can't free because of slow requests -> accumulator never trims.

liam: capture that for postmortem. For now mitigation = disable prefetch + smaller batches + forced eviction interval. Can we add eviction backoff to runbook?

devon: added interim eviction override: EVICT_IMMEDIATE=true on all continuous-batcher pods. patch applied.

ops-bot: monitor: continuous-batcher error-rate -> 3.2% -> 0.4% over 12m. Latency p95 -> 3.2s -> 220ms. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: customer impact severity updated: degraded (partial). Next update in 30m or on significant changes.

maya: CS draft: "We are experiencing elevated latency and intermittent errors for generation and chat features in us-west-2. We have applied mitigations and are continuing to monitor. Follow-ups: kernel/driver investigation, batcher deadlock fix, postmortem."

charu: creating a minimal failing test in CI to catch this. PR #7890 opened with test + initial fix to eviction logic.

liam: handoff: I'm oncall for another 15m then hand to maya. Post-handoff plan: track the hardware replacement ticket and the PR run. If metrics stay stable for 60m, de-escalate.

maya: taking over in 15. confirmed runbook steps logged in incident doc.

devon: note — we also routed gen traffic for high-critical customers to Dedicated pools as temporary fallback. Config changes logged in infra audit.

charu: telemetry link: https://monitoring.redwood/graphs/continuous-batcher/us-west-2?from=-60m

liam: good. action items summary pinned:
- disable prefetch (done)
- reduce batch soft limit (done)
- set eviction immediate (done)
- drain faulty node and scale up (done)
- open hardware ticket for GPU reset (assigned to infra-hw)
- PR for deadlock fix (charu)
- customer comms by CS (maya)

incident-bot: 4923456910 — auto-note: runbook step 3 executed by devon.

maya: 30m check: metrics stable, p95 < 400ms, errors < 0.5%. Keeping this open until hardware ticket resolved and PR merged.

devon: will schedule a canary redeploy with patched eviction in staging then prod after validation. ETA for merge+canary ~4h.

charu: adding postmortem owners: charu, devon, liam. Drafting timeline and root cause (KV eviction deadlock + GPU driver flakiness causing compounded OOMs).

maya: thanks team — good mitigation work. I'll update status page and CS thread. Closing incident when PR merged and hardware replaced. :white_check_mark:
